Pu rpose / Description of Event This event is a workshop conducted for budget officer training and professional development, involving 75 participants comprised of Financial Management Officers (FMOs) and Financial Specialists from all East Asia and Pacific (EAP) Region U.S. Embassies. The workshop will cover financial and budgetary topics relevant to Embassy financial operations across the EAP region over a four -day period in Jakarta, Indonesia. (This section should clearly explain what the event is for and who is involved. So please elaborate as clearly as possible).
